Use this data source to query detailed information of TKE addon values.

> **Note:** `values` is the rendering result of the parameters you configured merged with the
default parameters of the chart. It is **not** empty for an addon that is not installed in the
cluster, as long as the chart exists in the addon repository: in that case `values` is exactly
equal to `defaultValues` and contains no cluster information (for example `global.cluster.id`
is an empty string). To check whether an addon is actually installed, use the
`tencentcloud.Kubernetes.getAddons` data source instead.

```typescript
import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as std from "@pulumi/std";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const example = tencentcloud.kubernetes.getAddonValues({
    clusterId: "cls-5yezvaxo",
    addonName: "ip-masq-agent",
});
const currentValues = example.then(example => std.jsondecode({
    input: example.values,
})).then(invoke => invoke.result);
const availableValues = example.then(example => std.jsondecode({
    input: example.defaultValues,
})).then(invoke => invoke.result);
export const addonCurrentValues = currentValues;
export const addonAvailableValues = availableValues;
```
